string.text: Open the door to the control room
This door must lead to the control room, but it's sealed tight. I'll have to track down the circuit breaker and cut the power. With any luck, that should open it.
Locate the distribution panel and cut the power

I can't simply shut this thing down. First I have to redirect the antenna to another sector from the control panel, then input a code. The problem is - which code? I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in those encrypted documents I've been gathering all across the Zone. On top of that, I still need to find that damn access card...
